messages.en:
{07 13 00}Bugs are so adorable! I
just want to hug them
to pieces!
{07 16 00}But then there'd be bug
juice all over the place!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 07 00}Ewwwwwwww!
messages.et:
{07 13 00}Putukad on nii armsad! Ma
tahan neid lihtsalt
puruks kallistada!
{07 16 00}Aga siis oleks putukamahl
üle kogu põranda!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 07 00}Äääääkh!

messages.en:
{07 17 00}It's kinda embarrassing, but
my room is totally packed
with bugs right now!
{07 14 00}You aren't totally grossed
out by that, are you,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
messages.et:
{07 17 00}Veidi piinlik, aga mu tuba
on praegu täiesti
putukaid täis!
{07 14 00}Sind ei aja see ju
üldse jälestama, ega,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Let's get together
sometime and kick back and
watch some bugs!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Saame kunagi kokku ja
laseme lõdvaks ja
vaatame putukaid!
